policies.with_check: ((auth.uid() = user_id) AND (status = 'pending'::text) AND (completed_at IS NULL) AND (expires_at IS NULL))
((auth.uid() = user_id) AND (status = 'cancelled'::text) AND (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL))
((auth.uid() = user_id) AND (status = 'pending'::text) AND (cancelled_at IS NULL) AND (completed_at IS NULL))

((auth.uid() = author_id) AND is_active_profile(author_id) AND (status = 'active'::text) AND (deleted_at IS NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM posts p
  WHERE ((p.id = comments.post_id) AND (p.status = 'active'::text) AND (p.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (NOT is_blocked_pair(auth.uid(), p.author_id))))))

policies.qual:
((status = 'active'::text) AND (deleted_at IS NULL) AND (NOT is_blocked_pair(auth.uid(), author_id)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM posts p
  WHERE ((p.id = comments.post_id) AND (p.status = 'active'::text) AND (p.deleted_at IS NULL) AND is_active_profile(p.author_id) AND (NOT is_blocked_pair(auth.uid(), p.author_id))))))

policies.with_check: ((auth.uid() = user_id) AND (profile_status <> 'published'::text) AND (verification_status = ANY (ARRAY['not_requested'::text, 'submitted'::text])) AND (affiliation_verification_status = ANY (ARRAY['unverified'::text, 'submitted'::text])))

((auth.uid() = follower_id) AND (follower_id <> following_id) AND live_alerts_enabled AND is_active_profile(follower_id) AND is_active_profile(following_id) AND is_approved_creator(following_id) AND (NOT is_blocked_pair(follower_id, following_id)))

policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ((industry_organization_members member
     JOIN industry_organizations org ON ((org.id = member.organization_id)))
     JOIN profiles profile ON ((profile.id = member.user_id)))
  WHERE ((member.organization_id = industry_creator_session_handoffs.organization_id) AND (member.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (member.status = 'active'::text) AND (org.status = 'active'::text) AND (profile.account_status = 'active'::text))))

policies.with_check: (is_industry_org_manager(organization_id) AND (created_by = auth.uid()) AND (status = 'draft'::text) AND (approved_at IS NULL))
(is_industry_org_member(organization_id) AND (opened_by = auth.uid()) AND (status = 'open'::text) AND (closed_at IS NULL))

((auth.uid() = user_id) AND is_active_profile(user_id) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM posts p
  WHERE ((p.id = post_likes.post_id) AND (p.status = 'active'::text) AND (p.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (NOT is_blocked_pair(auth.uid(), p.author_id))))))

policies.qual:
((NOT is_blocked_pair(auth.uid(), user_id)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM posts p
  WHERE ((p.id = post_likes.post_id) AND (p.status = 'active'::text) AND (p.deleted_at IS NULL) AND is_active_profile(p.author_id) AND (NOT is_blocked_pair(auth.uid(), p.author_id))))))

policies.with_check:
((auth.uid() = author_id) AND is_active_profile(author_id) AND (status = 'active'::text) AND (deleted_at IS NULL) AND ((NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM creator_profiles cp
  WHERE (cp.user_id = posts.author_id)))) OR is_approved_creator(author_id)))

policies.qual: ((status = 'active'::text) AND (deleted_at IS NULL) AND (NOT is_blocked_pair(auth.uid(), author_id)) AND is_active_profile(author_id))
